## Summary

Describe the behavior-preserving change and its validation.

## Repository quality checklist

- [ ] New components are in the correct shared or feature-owned location.
- [ ] Canonical Monolith primitives are reused.
- [ ] No module-specific design-system primitive or variant was added.
- [ ] No duplicate CSS token or hardcoded semantic color was added.
- [ ] No unmanaged root script, generated output, log, or scratch copy is tracked.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Routes, API contracts, server actions, permissions, and business rules are unchanged unless explicitly documented.
- [ ] Light, Night, and Violet themes were checked for presentation changes.
- [ ] `npm run audit:structure` and relevant quality gates were run.
